easyPrerequisites: You are able to kill Zabaz such that it won't have a -1/-1 counter on it when it dies.
description:
Kill Zabaz.
When Zabaz dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Zabaz from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Zabaz dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness
Repeat from step 2.
